title: Classic Workspace Host
description: the workspace host — the pane container with splits, tiling, chat-presence backdrop and room overlays. Ships the shipped implementation (HOST_SPLITS) from @fraym/ui rather than a reduced lookalike, so a fully marketplace-assembled space is byte-identical to the built-in one. The center pane. Before this pack no marketplace part had ever filled the `workspace` contract, so every space fell through to the shipped host.
